summary: Two climbers (male and female, early 30s) stranded on the Bastille in Eldorado Canyon State Park after their rappel rope lodged in the rocks ~100 ft above the roadway; lowered back to the roadway uninjured after a ~90-minute operation
location: The Bastille, Eldorado Canyon State Park
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group
notes: Incident date 2019-09-03 (Tuesday per BCSO release, parent-opened). BCSO case #19-5131. Mined from the govdelivery COBOULDER 2019-bulletin angle, run 730 chunk A.
